headline: Moderna Raises 2026 Sales Outlook, Driving Stock Gain
summary: Moderna shares rose after the biotech firm raised its full-year revenue outlook, projecting revenue growth of up to 25% in 2026.
why: Moderna Inc. is a prominent biotechnology company focused on messenger RNA (mRNA) therapeutics and vaccines, making its forward-looking revenue guidance a key indicator for the biotech sector.

impacts.name: Moderna
impacts.why: Higher projected revenue growth directly boosts investor sentiment and valuation for the company.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The upward revision of sales expectations for 2026 directly caused investors to revalue the company's future cash flows upward.
